features.quote: I built failure scenarios that are honestly categorized in the harness
features.justification_quote: the value of the test is fidelity to real conditions, not concealment

features.quote: made the headline regression metric the **resilience (composure) rate**, which goes up as the model improves
features.justification_quote: optimizing "make it melt down as cheaply as possible" ... is not the same target as "robust in realistic conditions"
